action.objective: Consolidate the queen on b5 where it pressures a5/b4 and pins Black's weak queenside pawns while keeping the position safe.

Safety complete with no mate-in-one and tactical_refutation not_found, no proven refutations. It attacks b4 and a5, contesting Black's queenside. No stronger alternative is verified; c2c4 only reached depth 2 with a lower score and is unrefuted compared at shared depth.
